posts.title: Darja notes 2026
posts.description: Back from holiday; this year's miscellaneous observations on Darja follow. posts.title: S/š-Ṭ-Ḥ in Algerian Arabic
posts.description: On holiday in Algeria, I've been going frequently to some coastal rocks called əṣ-Ṣṭuħ الصطوح, from the plural of ṣṭəħ صطح "flat terrace roof", and occasionally eating šṭiṭħa شطيطحة "stew". I haven't done any dancing ( šṭiħ شطيح) - not really my thing. posts.title: Comparative East Chadic B evidence on the Mubi pronominal series
posts.description: Mubi is the best described member of a small "Mubic" subgroup consisting of Masmedje, Kajakse, and Zerenkel. The other members are much more poorly described, but enough can be gleaned from published materials to show that they share essentially the same system of subject pronominal suffix series with different syntactic functions .
